description: Search CCPEDIA's indexed Canton talks/videos (YouTube transcripts). Canton-specific. Returns matches across title + transcript with the best-matching passage, its time in the video and a link that opens the video there.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

query.description: Free-text query. Appears in title or transcript.
